text:
You need a multi-page React app for a school project with JWT login/signup, a SQL/Node backend, and API pages that use GET, POST, and PUT requests.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’ve spent 7 years building full-stack apps with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Tailwind CSS.

In a recent Streaming chat widget (p16), I built the React front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streamed answers token by token, with the first token on screen in about 600 ms. In a Live fleet dashboard (p02), I built a dispatcher map that showed every truck’s position and ETA as GPS pings arrived, tracking 1,800 trucks live.

I can build the two-page structure, wire up JWT auth, and connect the API calls cleanly for your school project. Would you like the backend to be kept simple with a basic SQL schema and CRUD endpoints?
